one_line: The paper develops and validates an Energy Performance Indicators methodology, applied to an Italian consumer-goods manufacturing plant with four discrete production departments, an on-site palm-oil cogeneration unit, and technical utilities—discrete manufacturing, not continuous-flow process industry.
